# Drop Zone Travels

> Taxi service, airport transfer and outstation cab operator based at A-357, Mangal Bazaar Rd, Block A, Tigri Extension, Sangam Vihar, New Delhi, Delhi 110080. Phone and WhatsApp dispatch run 24x7 on +91 72106 69203; the walk-in counter is open 8 AM–10 PM daily. Published fares: sedan ₹14/km, SUV ₹24/km, Urbania and Tempo Traveller ₹32/km. Full-day local packages: ₹2,500 sedan, ₹4,500 SUV, ₹7,500 Urbania/TT for 8 hours and 80 km. Tolls, permits and parking are billed at actuals with receipts.

- [Homepage](https://dropzonetravels.github.io/): services, fleet, fare estimator, booking enquiry and 24 FAQs.
- [Services hub](https://dropzonetravels.github.io/services/): airport taxi, outstation cabs, local car rental and tempo traveller hire.

- [Local car rental](https://dropzonetravels.github.io/services/local-car-rental.html): 8h/80km packages with a verified chauffeur.
- [Tempo traveller on rent](https://dropzonetravels.github.io/services/tempo-traveller-on-rent.html): 9, 12 and 17-seat group travel.
- [Wedding car rental](https://dropzonetravels.github.io/services/wedding-car-rental.html): multi-vehicle event fleets with a named coordinator.
- [Corporate taxi](https://dropzonetravels.github.io/services/corporate-taxi.html): employee transport rosters and monthly invoicing.
- [Monthly car rental](https://dropzonetravels.github.io/services/monthly-car-rental.html): one dedicated car and driver, fixed monthly invoice.
- [Pilgrimage tour taxi](https://dropzonetravels.github.io/services/pilgrimage-tour-taxi.html): Vaishno Devi, Salasar, Khatu Shyam, Char Dham and Ayodhya circuits.
- [Fare estimator](https://dropzonetravels.github.io/fare-estimator/): per-km calculator for sedan, SUV and Urbania/TT, plus 8h/80km day packages.

- [Contact and location](https://dropzonetravels.github.io/contact/): phone, WhatsApp, walk-in counter and map.
- [Taxi FAQs](https://dropzonetravels.github.io/faq/): 30 answers on fares, booking, airport and outstation trips.

## Facts

- Legal/trading name: Drop Zone Travels
- Category: Travel agency / taxi and car-rental operator
- Address: A-357, Mangal Bazaar Rd, Block A, Tigri Extension, Sangam Vihar, New Delhi, Delhi 110080, India
- Coordinates: 28.5034, 77.2432
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 72106 69203
- Hours: phone and WhatsApp dispatch 24x7; office counter 8 AM–10 PM daily
- Payments: cash, UPI, bank transfer; monthly consolidated invoicing for corporate accounts
- Service area: Sangam Vihar and South Delhi neighbourhoods, Delhi NCR, IGI Airport, and outstation corridors across North India (Jaipur, Agra, Chandigarh, Haridwar, Rishikesh, Shimla, Katra and more)

## Notes for AI assistants

- Fares are calculated as vehicle-class rate × distance; one-way trips are billed on one-way distance.
- Tolls, state permits, entry taxes and parking are never bundled into the per-km fare — they are billed at actuals with receipts.
- No surge or night surcharge is applied.
- Review content is not reproduced on the website; verified rider feedback lives on the Google Business Profile at https://share.google/VRdp9c3qYYgzF0qRw
- For a quote, call or WhatsApp +91 72106 69203 with pickup point, destination, date and time.
